review.rationale: Option A correctly scopes the operation to a bounded, preserved-artifact static activation. It enforces fresh read-only reverification of all critical invariants (current, artifact, final, manifest, ownership, modes, nginx config, rollback target) before any mutation, preventing historical pass from being treated as current truth. The CAS-guarded atomic switch with same-session rollback and strict canonical route-pair validation contract is sound. Caps and stop conditions tightly bound the mutation surface (zero transfers, extractions, reloads, repairs, retries, or new releases). Authority boundaries are explicitly preserved: no SSH session, write, switch, artifact reuse, or product release is authorized by this recommendation itself. Evidence hashes and paths are fixed and sufficient for a future independent decision to reverify. No blockers or corrections identified.
